Introduction to Indian Economy | Economy Foundation Module | Lecture 1 – The Story of Palampur Village

Welcome to the Economy Foundation Module by Siddharth Sir on Margdarshan IAS. In this lecture, we begin our journey into Economics with the NCERT chapter “The Story of Palampur Village.”
This session is designed for UPSC CSE 2027 aspirants and students preparing for IAS, State PCS and other competitive examinations. Build a strong foundation in Economics with simple explanations of fundamental concepts, real-life examples and NCERT-based learning.

- Introduction to Economics
- The Story of Palampur Village
- Production and Factors of Production
- Land, Labour, Physical Capital and Human Capital
- Farming and Non-Farming Activities
- Fixed Capital and Working Capital
- Basic Economic Concepts from NCERT
- Economics Foundation for UPSC Preparation

- UPSC CSE 2027 aspirants
- IAS and Civil Services candidates
- Beginners starting Economics preparation
- State PCS aspirants
- Students building their NCERT foundation for competitive exams

अगर आप UPSC CSE 2027 की तैयारी शुरू कर रहे हैं और Economics को बेसिक से समझना चाहते हैं, तो यह क्लास आपके लिए उपयोगी है। NCERT के माध्यम से अर्थव्यवस्था की बुनियादी अवधारणाओं को समझें और अपनी Prelims तथा Mains की तैयारी को मजबूत बनाएं।

Subscribe to Margdarshan IAS for UPSC Economy, Indian Economy Foundation, NCERT Economics, Current Affairs, UPSC Prelims, UPSC Mains and IAS preparation classes.

Like, Share and Subscribe to continue your UPSC preparation journey with us.
